record.rubric_notes: The candidate fully resolves the requested assessment: it identifies one nearly full-length 1–142 region, selects a Globins-family (a.1.1.2; SUNID 46463) hypothesis as the strongest supported level, and explicitly preserves the non-official, non-definitive boundary.
